description: Start an idempotency key or return the prior outcome. fingerprint is a hex hash. Call keys.create once. Pass caller_key on every later tools/call.

caller_key.description: pf_ key from keys.create. Pass this on tools/call when Authorization and X-Caller-Key are not set. A header key wins if both are set.

name: idem.begin
title: Begin idempotency
